instruction: Install and configure Varnish with multiple backends
output:
<think>
1. Task Breakdown:
   1. Prepare the host configuration with the required parameters
   2. Apply the configuration and verify with `cat status`
   3. Enable persistence across reboots if applicable

2. Tool Selection & Logic:
   Primary tool: `cat` — cat command execution and management
   Supporting tool: `host` — host command execution and management
   Supporting tool: `systemctl` — manage systemd services and units

3. Safety & Edge Cases:
   SERVICE: restart only during maintenance window; verify unit dependencies with `systemctl list-dependencies`
</think>
cat > /etc/varnish/default.vcl << 'EOF'
vcl 4.1;
backend web1 { .host = "192.168.1.10"; .port = "80"; }
backend web2 { .host = "192.168.1.11"; .port = "80"; }
sub vcl_recv {
  set req.backend_hint = web1;
  if (req.restarts > 0) { set req.backend_hint = web2; }
}
sub vcl_backend_response {
  set beresp.grace = 1h;
}
EOF && systemctl reload varnish
